officialNotice.title: Curriculum Errata Notice — 2027 Level I CFA Program (September 2026, 39 pages)

topicWeightsSource.note: Mock candidate allocation (180 selected + 10 reserves = 190 candidates) matches official 2027 Level I session/topic ranges.

impacts.detail: Bank uses FCFE = OCF - Capex + Net Borrowing; share repurchases/issuances do not enter FCFE directly.

impacts.area: Cash conversion cycle direction when stretching AP (Notice p. 19)
impacts.detail: All CCC items use DOH + DSO - DPO so higher DPO decreases CCC.
Items accurately state empirical duration uses statistical estimation on historical data while analytical uses mathematical formulas.
Periodicity=2 conversions and convexity sign/scaling match semiannual conventions.

impacts.area: Hedge fund incentive fee ordering post-management-fee & HWM (Notice pp. 35-36)
impacts.detail: Both items deduct management fee before computing incentive fee above the high-water mark.

impacts.area: Standard III(C) suitability & mandate consistency (Notice p. 38)
impacts.detail: Mandate/IPS consistency language aligns with restored Standard III(C) text.

impacts.area: Capitalized vs. expensed interest cash-flow classification (Notice p. 4)
impacts.detail: Items test general OCF/FCF classification and indirect OCF rather than the specific Example 5 investing-cash-flow erratum.
